execution.resume: Only exact configuration and source hashes may reuse completed auxiliary stages

fitting.main_reuse: Reuse existing model, arrays, selection and EM history without fitting
fitting.neuron_subset: First n neurons in the existing fixed 512-column order; no neuron reselection
fitting.normalization: Per-neuron raw training standard deviation ddof=1 across original frames 50:300, floor=0.01*mean(std); recompute only on each profile's training trials/neurons
fitting.selection: Within each fixed dimension, select initialization by validation neural likelihood; final fit uses training trials only
fitting.training_subset: For train50, sorted first floor(n_train/2) indices from default_rng(42).permutation(n_train); all main validation trials retained

interpretation: Sensitivity of conclusion direction within one session; latent coordinates and absolute geometries differ across profiles; no optimal dimension or GPFA selection claim

model_comparison.computation: Exact memoization of identical condition multiplicities is allowed; keep all 2000 draws
model_comparison.resampling_unit: Whole movie condition, paired between Static and Dynamic
model_comparison.response_matching: No new selection or matched-control analysis

preservation: Never change main weights, split, normalization, configuration, caches, matching choice, or result files

reconstruction.estimator: Observation model C z + d, with the frozen offline posterior; no fitted downstream readout
reconstruction.historical_equivalence: C z + d and R2 reuse the documented diagnostic; the exact historical denominator implementation is unavailable and equivalence is unverified
reconstruction.per_neuron_r2: Same ratio with sums over evaluated trial/condition and time, separately per neuron
reconstruction.scale: Profile training-standard-deviation-scaled raw responses; no centering or clipping

reliability.main_balanced: Copy existing observed/null scores; do not recompute or replace them
reliability.null_location: Apply existing response-space nulls on the full-time training-scaled neural responses before posterior inference
reliability.randomness: Save exact per-null RNG states; reuse the 512-neuron transformation draws, then select nested neuron columns for neurons256
reliability.sampling: Reproduce main seed-42 RNG stream including null draws; retain unsorted permutation prefixes for uniform nested k=1/k=2 sides; verify balanced memberships against the existing main split-identity CSV
reliability.uncertainty: Repeat-split distribution only, not independent biological samples
